Sentence (English): Delivery and installation by Hermes worked without any problems.
Comments (English): [ Great device ] || ---------------- || Delivery and installation by Hermes worked without any problems. The dishwasher makes a good, solid impression. I used it for a while before I gave this rating. The dishwasher works reliably and very thoroughly. Even in the short program, the dishes are very clean without streaks. Even the encrusted roasting pan was super clean in the normal wash cycle with the activation of the intensive cleaning in the lower basket. I think the app that comes with it is particularly great Download more cleaning programs for free from the app. The dishwasher has enough space. There are three of us and the machine often only runs every two days. I found the cutlery drawer a bit harder to get used to than putting things in. It is cleared out much faster than a basket, since you can pre-sort the cutlery here Dishwasher very satisfied and can recommend it unreservedly
Comments (Original): [ Super Gerät ] || ---------------- || Lieferung und Einbau durch Hermes klappte ohne Probleme.Der Geschirrspüler macht einen guten, soliden Eindruck. Hab ihn nun mal eine Weile benutzt, bevor ich diese Bewertung abgebe.Der Geschirrspüler arbeitet zuverlässig und sehr gründlich Selbst im Kurzprogramm wird das Geschirr sehr sauber, ohne Schlieren. Selbst der verkrustete Bräter wurde im Normalwaschgang mit Zuschaltung der Intensivreinigung im unteren Korb mega sauber.Besonders toll finde ich die dazugehörige App.Diese zeigt an, wann Salz und Klarapüler aufgefüllt werden müssen oder wenn es Zeit ist, das Reinigungsprogramm zu benutzenAußerdem kann man sich in der App weitere Reinigungsprogramme kostenlos herunterladen. Platz hat der Geschirrspüler ausreichend. Wir sind zu dritt und oft läuft die Maschine nur alle zwei Tage.Ein wenig gewöhnungsbedürftig fand ich die BesteckschubladeEher vom einräumen her.Ausgeräumt ist sie viel schneller als ein Korb, da man hier das Besteck schön vorsortieren kann.Alles in allem sind wir mit dem Geschirrspüler sehr zufrieden und können diesen uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen

Sentence (English): We do not use a dishwasher now, but since we have applied for the LG dishwasher option for the new apartment we will move in two years later, expectations for the LG dishwasher are very high.
Comments (English): We do not use a dishwasher now, but since we have applied for the LG dishwasher option for the new apartment we will move in two years later, expectations for the LG dishwasher are very high. It was useful. I was very fortunate to have LG Electronics as an option for electronic products. The design is pretty and it is durable and doesn't break, so I usually prefer LG products, but I was really happy that LG electronics were included as an option. We use a dishwasher. I also chose the option, but in particular, my husband wanted a dishwasher. Usually housewives want to use a dishwasher more, but in my house, my husband unconditionally insisted that he do it, so we used the dishwasher this time, and we are especially happy to use it with LG Electronics.LG It seems that the biggest expectation for dishwashers is hot air drying, the last drying step. Existing dishwashers of other companies do not dry by opening the door after drying, or open the door automatically and then go to the drying function without drying with hot air. I think the efficiency of the part that is dried by hot air comes out after it is opened. I think it will be dried much faster if it is dried by open air than if it is dried in an airtight environment. Therefore, the overall washing time is also expected to be shortened. .It seems that the time to wash and dry the dishwasher will be shortened a lot. In addition, there are so many indescribable advantages such as steam sterilization and electricity cost of 93 won per use, so I am really looking forward to using the LG Dios dishwasher! Sentence (English): Wow, the dishwasher I've been longing for has finally arrived, free your hands and give yourself a holiday.

Sentence (English): I truly love my whirlpool dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher with Great Installation ] || ---------------- || I truly love my whirlpool dishwasher. I've had it about two months and have no complaints. It's quiet and cleans thoroughly. I took out the included silverware basket and use the third rack for all of my silverware, including pizza wheels, silicone spatulas, and tongs - all getting perfectly clean! The process of delivery and installation was also super easy. I'm not sure if it is the case for all locations but my location had the installation company pick up my dishwasher from a Costco warehouse and deliver to my house. The installation company called within a day of my order to schedule the installation as well as called to confirm the night before. The representative was thorough in explaining the installation process and made me aware ahead of time what other things the installer would be looking for - asking location of outlets and what type of waterline was connected to my old dishwasher. Because my house is older the previous dishwasher was hardwired to my house electrical box and the waterline running to the dishwasher was copper. The representative noted that the installer would add an outlet behind the dishwasher to the new unit to be plugged into and that they would replace the copper line and check the shutoff valves under the sink. Please note that these items did cost extra and were not included in the standard Costco delivery. The day of delivery, the installers were prompt and efficient in their work and removed the old dishwasher and trash from unboxing. They checked the dishwasher did not have any leaks and that the unit was level and set back into its place properly. Overall I was very happy with the whole process and happy with my dishwasher. I would purchase other appliances from Costco.

Sentence (English): We are very happy with our Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, excellent cleaning, but oh that door.  ] || ---------------- || We are very happy with our Bosch dishwasher. It does a fine job of cleaning, and that is what it was bought to do - clean! We run 95% of cleaning loads on the Speed60 cycle and that does the trick. There has been little need to run the dishwasher on a longer cycle. Seems wasteful. This dishwasher is incredibly quiet, a welcome change from every dishwasher we have used in the past. Overall, it is a nice machine. What keeps us from awarding 5 stars? That darn DOOR! The springs are SO tight, making it a challenge to get the door fully opened with ease. And it has a tendency to want to pull the door closed, making it difficult to just open it quickly to insert a dirty dish or utensil. To do a quick insert, two hands are required, and one hand must remain on the door or it will slam shut on the other hand. Not ideal. We had a repair person visit in hopes that there might be a fix for this, and sadly there is not. Would we buy this machine again? Probably not, because of the door issue.

Sentence (English): We are very happy with our Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, excellent cleaning, but oh that door.  ] || ---------------- || We are very happy with our Bosch dishwasher. It does a fine job of cleaning, and that is what it was bought to do - clean! We run 95% of cleaning loads on the Speed60 cycle and that does the trick. There has been little need to run the dishwasher on a longer cycle. Seems wasteful. This dishwasher is incredibly quiet, a welcome change from every dishwasher we have used in the past. Overall, it is a nice machine.What keeps us from awarding 5 stars? That darn DOOR! The springs are SO tight, making it a challenge to get the door fully opened with ease. And it has a tendency to want to pull the door closed, making it difficult to just open it quickly to insert a dirty dish or utensil. To do a quick insert, two hands are required, and one hand must remain on the door or it will slam shut on the other hand. Not ideal. We had a repair person visit in hopes that there might be a fix for this, and sadly there is not.Would we buy this machine again? Probably not, because of the door issue.

Sentence (English): For many commodities, installation and debugging have a great impact on the final user experience.
Comments (English): For many commodities, installation and debugging have a great impact on the final user experience. Midea's installation service this time made me really dare not buy products that require Midea's installation in the future. The problems are as follows: 1. There is no appointment. Order was placed on the 16th, and the system displayed installation on the 18th. No one made an appointment with me on the 17th, and I specifically contacted the customer service, and only one reply said "someone will contact you within 24 hours". The 18th passed, no one contacted, and the customer service replied that they would deal with it. On the 18th, I didn't dare to go out and waste a day. On the weekend 2, the installation was postponed. On the 19th, the master called and asked if he could install it in the afternoon. I left my parents waiting at home 3, unprofessional installation. My parents said that the master had never installed a dishwasher and was not qualified to install it. The qualification certification 4 temporarily done on the app is not responsible for the installation. There is a tee for launching in the installation. The original sewer pipe in my house was plugged into the drain pipe of the sink, which was relatively tight. The master didn't pull it out, and the tee was not installed. Just lightly plug the dishwasher drain into the downpipe and you're done. I got home at night and despite the first 3 issues, I was happy that the new stuff worked. Use it after eating. After a while, I went to the kitchen and found a layer of sewage on the ground. Just found problem 4. Dishwasher drain doesn't go down the drain at all, it's all in the cabinet under the sink and then on the floor. I ended up cutting and ripping out the sink drain myself and letting the dishwasher finish. It stinks now, and tomorrow I have to buy a water pipe to connect the tee myself (I dare not find a beautiful one). The cabinet under the sink is soaked in water, and I don’t know if there will be a problem.
Comments (Original): 很多商品，安装调试对最终使用体验影响很大。这次美的的安装服务，让我真的以后不敢再买需要美的安装的产品了。问题有以下几个：1，没有预约。16号下单，系统显示18号安装。17号没有人和我预约，我还特意联系客服，就一个回复说“24小时内有人联系”。18号过去了，没人联系，客服答复说他们处理。18号没敢出去浪费一天周末2，延期安装。19号师傅电话问下午能不能装。我不在家，就让父母在家里等着3，安装不专业。我父母说，师傅没装过洗碗机，也没有安装资格。临时在app上做的资格认证4，安装不负责。安装中有一个下水的三通。我家原来的下水管道塞了水槽的下水管，比较紧。师傅没拔出来，三通就没装。把洗碗机的下水往下水管里浅浅的一塞，就完工了。我晚上回到家，虽然有前3个问题，但是新东西能用了还是挺高兴。吃了饭就用上了。过一会去厨房，发现地面一层污水。才发现了问题4。洗碗机排水根本进不到下水管，全都留到水槽下面的柜子里，然后留到地面上了。最终我自己把水槽下水管剪断扯出来，让洗碗机洗完了。现在一身臭，明天还要买水管自己接三通(不敢找美的了)水槽下面的柜子被泡了水，也不知道会不会有问题。

Sentence (English): Quite satisfied.

After abandoning it, I was worried about the quality of the domestic machine, so I wanted to buy Siemens instead. With the mood of giving it a try, I bought Haier. I have been using it for two months and am quite satisfied. Baking pans, frying pans, and cleaning are no problem. The noise is not too loud. Bought an extended warranty, more peace of mind. Although the narrow one is more expensive, it saves space.

Sentence (English): Very satisfied with the machine (previously the old Bosch machine probably served us for close to 20 years).
Comments (English): [ Excellent ] || ---------------- || Very satisfied with the machine (previously the old Bosch machine probably served us for close to 20 years). New ones dry better (also plastic containers). We have the function to open the door on because we usually wash at night and it dries a bit more. This is also useful for starting up if we are traveling somewhere because we can start the machine before we travel and it will open and shut itself off. The difference with the old one is also the upper accessory drawer. This one takes a bit longer to fold, if too many together it doesn't wash well. The old man had a basket, which I carried to the drawer and put the utensils in the drawer, and here you can quickly collect all the spoons, for example. This drawer is very convenient for washing seals and caps and smaller items, which used to fly everywhere with the old one and I ended up finding under the drawers. The flexibility of all holders for plates, glasses, etc. is also excellent, because everything can be folded, even in parts, cheaper models have a little less of this flexibility. The old machine had functions and a screen on the front, which is completely covered and projects the time all the way onto the floor, which is great. However, when we ordered the kitchen, we already predicted that the old machine would one day say goodbye (even though it worked for 9 years after that) and we ordered an additional side for a fully built-in machine like this one, so now we had no problems with installation or get a new side to match the kitchen. It also has the function of connecting to Wi-Fi, but we did not activate it, so I cannot comment on that. The programs take a long time, eco, which we mostly use for about 4 hours, but I don't mind because I wash mostly at night (it's not loud, except when you open the drawer for the washing machine, it makes noise). Very satisfied. we recommend!
Comments (Original): [ Odličen ] || ---------------- || Zelo zadovoljna s strojem (pred tem nam je star Boschev stroj služil verjetno blizu 20 let). Novi bolje suši (tudi plastične posode). Vklopljeno imamo funkcijo za odpiranje vrat, ker navadno pomivamo v nočnem času in se še nekoliko bolj posuši. To je uporabno tudi, za zagon, če kam odpotujemo, ker lahko stroj zaženemo preden odpotujemo in se bo sam odprl in ugasnil. Razlika s starim je tudi zgornji predal za pribor. Ta vzame nekoliko več časa za zlaganje, če je preveč skupaj ni najbolje oprano. Stari je imel košarico, ki sem jo nesla do predala in zložila pribor v predal, tu pa se lahko hitro pobere npr vse žlice. Ta predal je zelo priročen za pranje tesnil in pokrovčkov ter manjših predmetov, kar je pri starem včasih letelo povsod in sem na koncu našla pod predali. Odlična je tudi fleksibilnost vseh držal za krožnike, kozarce itd, ker je vse možno zložiti, tudi po delih, cenejši modeli imajo nekoliko manj te fleksibilnosti. Stari stroj je imel fukncije in zaslon še spredaj, ta je cel pokrit in projicira čas do konca na tla, kar je super. Smo pa pri naročilu kuhinje že predvideli, da se bo stari stroj nekoč poslovil (čeprav je še po tem deloval 9 let) in smo naročili še dodatno stranico za  popolnoma vgradni stroj kot je ta, zato zdaj nismo imeli težav z montažo oz. dobiti novo stranico, ki bi se ujemala s kuhinjo. Ima funkcijo tudi priklopa na wifi, kar pa nismo aktivirila, torej tega ne morem komentirati. Programi trajajo dolgo, eco, ki ga večinoma uporabljamo cca 4 ure, vendar me ne moti, ker pomiva večinoma ponoči (ni glasen, razen ko odpre predalček za pralno stedstvo poči). Zelo zadovoljni...priporočamo!

Sentence (English): My dishwasher finally arrived!
Comments (English): [ I'm experiencing a new world of dishwashers. ] || ---------------- || My dishwasher finally arrived! Auntie! I've always wanted one, but my kitchen isn't very big, so a dishwasher that's too big would be a burden. But now that I've finally got a 3-person dishwasher, I'm so happy! I was surprised when it arrived. I thought it would be small since it's for 3 people, but I was surprised by how big the box was. It was carefully packaged in Styrofoam. Installation was simple, and it installed without any problems. Even I, a woman, found it incredibly easy to install. And most importantly, it's a no-drill design, so I can install it anywhere. Just plug in the drain and drain it toward the sink, and you're done! You have to manually add water, and they recommend turning it on while you're filling it. That way, the machine will notify you when the water level is high, so be sure to turn it on and fill it. The wheels make it easy to load and unload dishes, which is super convenient. The filter and strainer are also washable, which is nice. The 72-hour ventilation circulation drying system eliminates odors and keeps dishes clean. The powerful water jet and 360-degree rotation create a stream of water that sprays water into every nook and cranny, ensuring excellent cleaning performance. It also uses 72-degree hot water to thoroughly remove grease, making it even better than doing the dishes myself. It has five wash modes: Standard, Powerful, Eco, Quick, and Steam. Standard mode is ideal for after-meal use, while Powerful mode is great for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco mode is for quick washes, Quick mode is great for short wash times and no drying required, and Steam mode, with its steam and sterilizing capabilities, is perfect for washing baby bottles and children's dishes. The dishwasher detergent instructions say to use 6g. I use 5g capsules, and since they're capsules, I only need to add one, which is perfect. I've been using it for about a week and am extremely satisfied! This dishwasher has become indispensable. It's a whole new world! I wish I'd gotten one sooner. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

It also uses 72-degree hot water to thoroughly remove grease, making it even better than doing the dishes myself. It has five wash modes: Standard, Powerful, Eco, Quick, and Steam. Standard mode is ideal for after-meal use, while Powerful mode is great for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco mode is for quick washes, Quick mode is great for short wash times and no drying required, and Steam mode, with its steam and sterilizing capabilities, is perfect for washing baby bottles and children's dishes. The dishwasher detergent instructions say to use 6g. I use 5g capsules, and since they're capsules, I only need to add one, which is perfect. I've been using it for about a week and am extremely satisfied! This dishwasher has become indispensable. It's a whole new world! I wish I'd gotten one sooner. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ I'm experiencing a new world of dishwashers. ] || ---------------- || My dishwasher finally arrived! Auntie! It also uses 72-degree hot water to thoroughly remove grease, making it even better than doing the dishes myself. It has five wash modes: Standard, Powerful, Eco, Quick, and Steam. Standard mode is ideal for after-meal use, while Powerful mode is great for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco mode is for quick washes, Quick mode is great for short wash times and no drying required, and Steam mode, with its steam and sterilizing capabilities, is perfect for washing baby bottles and children's dishes. The dishwasher detergent instructions say to use 6g. I use 5g capsules, and since they're capsules, I only need to add one, which is perfect. I've been using it for about a week and am extremely satisfied! This dishwasher has become indispensable. It's a whole new world! I wish I'd gotten one sooner. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Eco mode is for quick washes, Quick mode is great for short wash times and no drying required, and Steam mode, with its steam and sterilizing capabilities, is perfect for washing baby bottles and children's dishes. I've been using it for about a week and am extremely satisfied! This dishwasher has become indispensable. It's a whole new world! I wish I'd gotten one sooner. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ I'm experiencing a new world of dishwashers. ] || ---------------- || My dishwasher finally arrived! Auntie! It also uses 72-degree hot water to thoroughly remove grease, making it even better than doing the dishes myself. It has five wash modes: Standard, Powerful, Eco, Quick, and Steam. Standard mode is ideal for after-meal use, while Powerful mode is great for greasy or heavily soiled dishes. Eco mode is for quick washes, Quick mode is great for short wash times and no drying required, and Steam mode, with its steam and sterilizing capabilities, is perfect for washing baby bottles and children's dishes. The dishwasher detergent instructions say to use 6g. I use 5g capsules, and since they're capsules, I only need to add one, which is perfect. I've been using it for about a week and am extremely satisfied! This dishwasher has become indispensable. It's a whole new world! I wish I'd gotten one sooner. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

While it is much quieter than our old one, the loading capacity is still a struggle with the types of dishes we use. The upper rack doesn't accommodate our small plates and bowls in a way that maximizes loading cups and mugs. Also, because of the top plastic cutlery drawer, you can't really let it air dry -- you have to use the heated drying feature. Otherwise the wet plastic top rack that is slow to dry just drips down over all the other dishes. Finally, in order to get dishes clean you need to rinse them before loading. It doesn't do a good job of cleaning dried-on food.

Comments (English): [ Energy saver that runs for hours… ] || ---------------- || My latest 2 month electric bill just showed up and it covers the entire time my new energy efficient appliance has been installed. Another issue I'm concerned about on this style washer, is how reliable the control panels touch pad might be? I'm not used to this type of interface and I'm concerned that touch contact switches protected by a waterproof membrane may not hold up to years of use. All things considered, the new washer is the most expensive appliance we purchased to date, and I'm hoping it lasts. It looks beautiful, cleans beautifully, and blends in nicely with existing appliance color and style. My wife loves it, now that's she's familiar with its capabilities and features.

But the installation was incorrect/improper (the mounting clips were just glued to the cabinet and broke off within a few days. ), so it had to be redone. Sentence (English): The dishwasher itself has the same factory standard, there is nothing to say.
Comments (English): The dishwasher itself has the same factory standard, there is nothing to say. I want to talk about after-sales installation, which can be described as very poor. When I bought it, I told the customer service that the installation location of my home is far away from the upper and lower water, and that an extension tube is needed, and the customer service said it was no problem. When it arrived, I contacted the installer, but they said no. Out of curiosity, I adjusted the goods as soon as I adjusted them. I adjusted them from somewhere for eight days. After the dishwasher arrived, I asked if it came on the eighth day. I said yes, but there are only water pipes and no joints for the water pipes. I am not happy, ask when. The installer was very interesting, and said that if I was in a hurry, I would buy one myself. I'm speechless, I don't know what diameter or model, how can I buy it? What is the cost of buying? I contacted Jingdong customer service and looked for outlets. The outlets are good. A phone call came and vaguely said that I always ask the after-sales service. I wanted to ask you why? When it comes to installation, the installer came up with an idea, install whatever you want, I said yes, let's see if I can install it first. When they came, they said they wanted to drill holes, two. Originally, one fifty-two was cheaper, and I was charged eighty or dozens. I was shocked. The product introduction of my wooden plank opening clearly stated that there was no charge. I said my house is made of wood, he said to ask and then ask the boss, and then changed to say that there is no charge. Very bad experience! After another week or so, the joint came and an appointment was made to install it. My house lacked a sewer pipe tee, and a tee was charged 50. I was away and my family paid directly. In summary, it takes less than one month from the arrival of the goods to the completion of the installation. No matter how good your product is, it will be enough to install it! Weigh it!

Sentence (English): I tend to procrastinate on washing dishes and rush through them.
Comments (English): [ A 12-person LG dishwasher with good price and performance ] || ---------------- || I tend to procrastinate on washing dishes and rush through them. The pile of dishes made me even more reluctant to do them. I tend to use a lot of water and take a long time to wash dishes. For these reasons, I started looking into dishwashers. I chose the LG dishwasher because it offered good performance, price, and design. I chose the DUBJ4GL because the green color was prettier than I expected, and the price was slightly cheaper than the Nature Beige. It had excellent basic features, including steam and hot air drying. It seemed better to have it and not use it than to not have it. I wanted it to have more features since I was already buying it. (I'm always using the steam and hot air dryers.) The differences between the models, such as L, S, or H, are in the basket, blade material, and frying pan holder, so I thought the L model would be sufficient. (The difference between the DUBJ4GS and the L is several hundred thousand won.) As a 12-person dishwasher, it held more loads than I expected, and the dishwasher cleaned very cleanly. The dried and sticky rice came off easily, and the seasonings came out clean. The steamed egg wasn't working well, so I had to scrub it and then add it. I used EcoBer detergent. I soaked it in dishwashing water and added it, and most of it came out clean even right away. Installation: If you select a date for the rocket installation, they call you that day. If you haven't done the sink installation and positioning, they'll reschedule the installation. Don't count the rocket installation date as the installation date; it's a good idea to set the date farther in advance and reschedule it with the installer. I originally scheduled the rocket for Saturday, but they called and postponed it to next week due to the rocket. I was worried about the mop base because the sink is high, but they cut it. They warned me that the sink might sink into the gas line because there's no support on the right side. The sink sank, or it was crooked, and it was sticking out a bit, but I think that varies from house to house. The installation went smoothly, and I've been using it for about two weeks without any issues. Coupang discounts are sometimes really cheap, so keep an eye out. My mother-in-law washes the dishes right away, so I wonder why she bought this. I haven't regretted it one bit since I bought it, and I don't think I'll ever go back to the days when I didn't have it.

Sentence (English): Costco's price is inclusive of everything, including all parts, labor, and haul-away.
Comments (English): [ Washes well, Drying not so great. ] || ---------------- || Costco's price is inclusive of everything, including all parts, labor, and haul-away. This is a very good deal for most people and the reason to buy appliances from Costco. For me personally, I wanted to do my own installation (and did). I did not ask Costco for a discount for that. However, I did run into snarky resistance from the 3rd party installer. Even though they would have gotten paid to just deliver the dishwasher, they tried to tell me they couldn't do that (even though it meant easy money for them not to have to install and get paid for it). A Costco rep made it all good and he was great. Why did I want to install it myself? Because these installation crews have multiple installations that need to get done each day and they don't have the time to deal with homeowner problems. We have two homes and had dishwashers installed in both in Dec 2022 & Feb 2023. Both had issues that installers would have never dealt with. On the first, the under-sink water purifier needed to be moved slightly to remove the drain hose. That movement caused one of the RO rubber seals to start dripping (because of hardening and displacement). Had I not done this installation myself, I would have not noticed the drips for some time and likely would have had a bigger water damage problem had I not replaced the seals. On the second installation, the water shutoff valve packing nut began to leak (not turned in likely over 12 years). Again, if I hadn't done the installation, the leak would likely have been overlooked. There are many reasons to install these yourself if you have the know-how. And if you take your time, the installation will go smoothly and will be done with your knowledge of possible issues. Note that these newer models try to maximize the space. If you have an older model you are replacing, these newer units are closer to the ground. That means more space for dishes, but also means less space for installation (especially on the bottom). So, pay attention to the routing of electrical line, water supply hose, and the drain hose. As for the Whirlpool WDT750SAKZ dishwasher, it's not their top of the line model. But it is attractive with a stainless steel housing, and washes dishes well. Be sure to use a Rinse Aid with these newer dishwashers. Otherwise, your dishes will spot and really not dry. Speaking of drying, even with the Rinse Aid, our dishes don't come out completely dry like our Bosch units had. We would have purchased another Bosch, however, the frequency of circulation pump failures are too high & costly (not an easy repair). So far, we're happy with the Whirlpool unit. The top rack for utensils is a welcomed addition and works well if you organize the placement of spoons, forks, & knives. The wash cycles can be pretty long if using the Normal setting. Although we're still experimenting with different cycles, we have few regrets. Fix the drying process, and this is a 5-star product assuming it demonstrates a decent lifespan track record. We bought our unit on sale for $579.

Sentence (English): So, this is replacing a 10 yr old GE Profile.
Comments (English): [ Fair dishwasher, but spend more and upgrade ] || ---------------- || So, this is replacing a 10 yr old GE Profile. It had more features than the Bosch, but wife said it needed to go. This is the entry-level Bosch dishwasher. It is louder than my older GE, but not loud generally. We can still comfortably have a conversation or watch TV and not be bothered by it. I do not like not having a heated dry and having wet plasticware. Seems that it is an energy savings thing and you must use the drying liquid. Even then, your plastics will always come out wet. It cleans well, however. Also, it does not have the little "garbage disposal" that our older one had. It was like a mini-blender that shredded any food products. Apparently, they result in too much noise, so manufacturers don't use them anymore as it is all about "the quiet. " I also dont like the cheap looking red LED display. Comments (English): [ That's good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much larger than I expected. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a bit bigger. The packaging is well-made with Styrofoam. The components inside are very well-packaged. No separate installation is required, so you can use it anywhere with space for a power cord and drainage. The power cord is short, so you'll need a nearby outlet. There are five modes: Standard, Strong, Eco, and Rapid Steam, so you can choose the one you want. There's also a timer function. The Rapid mode allows for a quick 30-minute wash. The dishwasher uses 72-degree high-pressure water, 360-degree rotations in two stages, and it's sprayed without any blind spots, thoroughly removing grease, chili powder, rice paste, and other debris, leaving dishes as clean as if they were washed by hand. It also has a 72-hour air circulation function for dish storage. However, this feature might be a bit of a concern for your electricity bill. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ That's good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much larger than I expected. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a bit bigger. The packaging is well-made with Styrofoam. The components inside are very well-packaged. No separate installation is required, so you can use it anywhere with space for a power cord and drainage. The power cord is short, so you'll need a nearby outlet. There are five modes: Standard, Strong, Eco, and Rapid Steam, so you can choose the one you want. There's also a timer function. The Rapid mode allows for a quick 30-minute wash. The dishwasher uses 72-degree high-pressure water, 360-degree rotations in two stages, and it's sprayed without any blind spots, thoroughly removing grease, chili powder, rice paste, and other debris, leaving dishes as clean as if they were washed by hand. It also has a 72-hour air circulation function for dish storage. However, this feature might be a bit of a concern for your electricity bill. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It also has a 72-hour air circulation function for dish storage. However, this feature might be a bit of a concern for your electricity bill. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ That's good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much larger than I expected. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a bit bigger. The packaging is well-made with Styrofoam. The components inside are very well-packaged. No separate installation is required, so you can use it anywhere with space for a power cord and drainage. The power cord is short, so you'll need a nearby outlet. There are five modes: Standard, Strong, Eco, and Rapid Steam, so you can choose the one you want. There's also a timer function. The Rapid mode allows for a quick 30-minute wash. The dishwasher uses 72-degree high-pressure water, 360-degree rotations in two stages, and it's sprayed without any blind spots, thoroughly removing grease, chili powder, rice paste, and other debris, leaving dishes as clean as if they were washed by hand. It also has a 72-hour air circulation function for dish storage. However, this feature might be a bit of a concern for your electricity bill. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ That's good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much larger than I expected. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a bit bigger. The packaging is well-made with Styrofoam. The components inside are very well-packaged. No separate installation is required, so you can use it anywhere with space for a power cord and drainage. The power cord is short, so you'll need a nearby outlet. There are five modes: Standard, Strong, Eco, and Rapid Steam, so you can choose the one you want. There's also a timer function. The Rapid mode allows for a quick 30-minute wash. The dishwasher uses 72-degree high-pressure water, 360-degree rotations in two stages, and it's sprayed without any blind spots, thoroughly removing grease, chili powder, rice paste, and other debris, leaving dishes as clean as if they were washed by hand. It also has a 72-hour air circulation function for dish storage. However, this feature might be a bit of a concern for your electricity bill. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ That's good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much larger than I expected. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a bit bigger. The packaging is well-made with Styrofoam. The components inside are very well-packaged. No separate installation is required, so you can use it anywhere with space for a power cord and drainage. The Rapid mode allows for a quick 30-minute wash. The dishwasher uses 72-degree high-pressure water, 360-degree rotations in two stages, and it's sprayed without any blind spots, thoroughly removing grease, chili powder, rice paste, and other debris, leaving dishes as clean as if they were washed by hand. It also has a 72-hour air circulation function for dish storage. However, this feature might be a bit of a concern for your electricity bill. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ That's good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much larger than I expected. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a bit bigger. The packaging is well-made with Styrofoam. The components inside are very well-packaged. No separate installation is required, so you can use it anywhere with space for a power cord and drainage. It also has a 72-hour air circulation function for dish storage. However, this feature might be a bit of a concern for your electricity bill. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. Comments (English): [ That's good ] || ---------------- || Wow, the box is much larger than I expected. I thought it was about the size of an oven-type air fryer, but it's a bit bigger. The packaging is well-made with Styrofoam. The components inside are very well-packaged. No separate installation is required, so you can use it anywhere with space for a power cord and drainage. The power cord is short, so you'll need a nearby outlet. There are five modes: Standard, Strong, Eco, and Rapid Steam, so you can choose the one you want. There's also a timer function. The Rapid mode allows for a quick 30-minute wash. The dishwasher uses 72-degree high-pressure water, 360-degree rotations in two stages, and it's sprayed without any blind spots, thoroughly removing grease, chili powder, rice paste, and other debris, leaving dishes as clean as if they were washed by hand. It also has a 72-hour air circulation function for dish storage. However, this feature might be a bit of a concern for your electricity bill. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. The packaging is well-made with Styrofoam. The components inside are very well-packaged. No separate installation is required, so you can use it anywhere with space for a power cord and drainage. It also has a 72-hour air circulation function for dish storage. However, this feature might be a bit of a concern for your electricity bill. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I haven't tried washing dishes yet, but I've only tried it, and the water flow is quite strong. It's quite noisy, and the sink floor vibrates, so using a noise-absorbing mat might be a good idea. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important. It also uses only 5 liters of water, significantly saving water compared to washing dishes by hand, reducing water waste. The dish rack is also equipped with wheels for smooth loading and removal. There's an LED lamp at the top of the dishwasher, which lights up when you open the door after washing, allowing you to remove dishes even in the dark. It's said that arranging dishes so they face each other from left to right during washing is more effective. It's also said that briefly rinsing dishes before placing them in the dishwasher will help ensure a cleaner wash. I'm so happy that the tedious task of washing dishes will be so much easier. There are some things you must keep in mind before using the dishwasher. The water inlet is located at the top of the machine, and you can fill it with water using the water inlet. Make sure the machine is turned on. A faucet icon will appear on the time display. Check this before filling. The water level sensor will sound an alarm when the water level reaches the level. The faucet icon will disappear. Then, you can stop the water supply and continue using the machine. Checkpoints: The most important thing is to always turn the machine on while filling! And use a dishwasher-specific detergent! Remember these two things. You must hold down the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn it on. Forced water drains by pressing the steam sterilization button and the preset button simultaneously for 3 seconds. However, this function is said to be used when moving the product when not in use for a long period of time, so use with caution. I'll add a review after washing the dishes. While the instructions and operation aren't difficult, I recommend reading the manual carefully before use even if you know how to use it. I'll add a review after use. First, the vibration and noise were reduced after I put the dishes in and spun them. I stir-fried dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken) and then rinsed it with water. I stacked the dishes with the bottom facing down because it was difficult to arrange them as instructed. I thought the regular mode would take longer, so I used the quick mode. The oil, red pepper powder, and kimchi were all cleaned cleanly. However, there was a dakgalbi smell. Could the smell be due to the detergent? I checked the dishwasher after washing. There was some chicken galbi grease on both corners of the front door. There was a rubber gasket underneath the door, and a lot of grease was also stained there. I removed the rubber gasket and wiped it with a wet tissue. I think cleaning this part is important.
