Although I received it for free, I'll write a review based on my experience using it. I'd never used a dishwasher before because it was expensive, didn't clean cleanly, and had been rumored to have a peculiar smell. But now I've found a dishwasher that shatters all my stereotypes: the Media Dishwasher! Let me introduce its advantages! 1. Powerful cleaning power. The most important thing about a dishwasher is how well it cleans and how residue-free it is. But there's really no need to worry. It cleans so thoroughly. When I first started using the dishwasher, I used to just wipe off almost all the dirt with a blister pack before using it. Now, I just roughly wipe it down and run it through the dishwasher. Whether I use a blister pack or not, it's still clean before and after! I think it's because the Media Dishwasher's high-pressure rotary jet system sprays powerful water from the top and bottom pumps! I'm very satisfied. 2. No peculiar smell. In the past, dishes in my dishwasher had a smell, but with the Media Dishwasher, there's no smell! It washes with hot water at 72 degrees Celsius, so the only smell is the fragrant detergent. 3. Various washing modes. I love that I can choose the washing mode based on the food I ate that day and the condition of the dishes. There are five functions: 1. Standard wash, 2. Power wash, 3. Eco wash, 4. Quick wash, and 5. Steam sterilization. I usually use the standard wash, but I only use the steam sterilization for my children's bottles and dishes! Then, I can use dishes that are as clean as new. 4. Easy installation and a pretty design. Even women can easily assemble it! The fact that it's a no-punch machine makes it easy to install even if you don't live at home. I installed it by myself in less than 10 minutes when my husband wasn't home. Now, there's only one drawback. Since it's a small dishwasher designed for three people, it won't fit large dishes. Since it's a three-person dishwasher, it's small, so large frying pans or dishes won't fit. So I wash the large dishes separately, and compared to before, the amount of dishes I wash has been cut in half, so it's not that inconvenient. For me! I'd recommend this to people who don't own a house, newlyweds, people who live alone, and mothers raising children. When you raise a child, especially a newborn, you use a lot of bottles, so you have to constantly wash them. I wash the bottles after the baby and repeat every day! Having a dishwasher can change your quality of life. And people who hate doing dishes and people who live alone can feel 100% satisfied if they use it! Whether I use a blister pack or not, it's still clean before and after! I think it's because the Media Dishwasher's high-pressure rotary jet system sprays powerful water from the top and bottom pumps! I'm very satisfied. 2. No peculiar smell. In the past, dishes in my dishwasher had a smell, but with the Media Dishwasher, there's no smell! It washes with hot water at 72 degrees Celsius, so the only smell is the fragrant detergent. 3. Various washing modes. I love that I can choose the washing mode based on the food I ate that day and the condition of the dishes. There are five functions: 1. Standard wash, 2. Power wash, 3. Eco wash, 4. Quick wash, and 5. Steam sterilization. I usually use the standard wash, but I only use the steam sterilization for my children's bottles and dishes! Then, I can use dishes that are as clean as new. 4. Easy installation and a pretty design. Even women can easily assemble it! The fact that it's a no-punch machine makes it easy to install even if you don't live at home. I installed it by myself in less than 10 minutes when my husband wasn't home. Now, there's only one drawback. Since it's a small dishwasher designed for three people, it won't fit large dishes. Since it's a three-person dishwasher, it's small, so large frying pans or dishes won't fit. So I wash the large dishes separately, and compared to before, the amount of dishes I wash has been cut in half, so it's not that inconvenient. For me! I'd recommend this to people who don't own a house, newlyweds, people who live alone, and mothers raising children. When you raise a child, especially a newborn, you use a lot of bottles, so you have to constantly wash them. I wash the bottles after the baby and repeat every day! Having a dishwasher can change your quality of life. And people who hate doing dishes and people who live alone can feel 100% satisfied if they use it! I think it's because the Media Dishwasher's high-pressure rotary jet system sprays powerful water from the top and bottom pumps! I'm very satisfied. 2. No peculiar smell. Then, I can use dishes that are as clean as new. 4. Easy installation and a pretty design. Even women can easily assemble it! I'd recommend this to people who don't own a house, newlyweds, people who live alone, and mothers raising children. When you raise a child, especially a newborn, you use a lot of bottles, so you have to constantly wash them. I wash the bottles after the baby and repeat every day! Having a dishwasher can change your quality of life. And people who hate doing dishes and people who live alone can feel 100% satisfied if they use it! I think it's because the Media Dishwasher's high-pressure rotary jet system sprays powerful water from the top and bottom pumps! I'm very satisfied. 2. No peculiar smell. I'd recommend this to people who don't own a house, newlyweds, people who live alone, and mothers raising children. When you raise a child, especially a newborn, you use a lot of bottles, so you have to constantly wash them. I wash the bottles after the baby and repeat every day! I'd never used a dishwasher before because it was expensive, didn't clean cleanly, and had been rumored to have a peculiar smell. Whether I use a blister pack or not, it's still clean before and after! I think it's because the Media Dishwasher's high-pressure rotary jet system sprays powerful water from the top and bottom pumps! I'm very satisfied. 2. No peculiar smell. In the past, dishes in my dishwasher had a smell, but with the Media Dishwasher, there's no smell! It washes with hot water at 72 degrees Celsius, so the only smell is the fragrant detergent. 3. Various washing modes. I love that I can choose the washing mode based on the food I ate that day and the condition of the dishes. There are five functions: 1. Standard wash, 2. Power wash, 3. Eco wash, 4. Quick wash, and 5. Steam sterilization. I usually use the standard wash, but I only use the steam sterilization for my children's bottles and dishes! Then, I can use dishes that are as clean as new. 4. Easy installation and a pretty design. Even women can easily assemble it! Now, there's only one drawback. Since it's a small dishwasher designed for three people, it won't fit large dishes. Since it's a three-person dishwasher, it's small, so large frying pans or dishes won't fit. So I wash the large dishes separately, and compared to before, the amount of dishes I wash has been cut in half, so it's not that inconvenient. For me! I'd recommend this to people who don't own a house, newlyweds, people who live alone, and mothers raising children. When you raise a child, especially a newborn, you use a lot of bottles, so you have to constantly wash them. I wash the bottles after the baby and repeat every day! Having a dishwasher can change your quality of life. And people who hate doing dishes and people who live alone can feel 100% satisfied if they use it! I think it's because the Media Dishwasher's high-pressure rotary jet system sprays powerful water from the top and bottom pumps! I'm very satisfied. 2. No peculiar smell. Then, I can use dishes that are as clean as new. 4. Easy installation and a pretty design. Even women can easily assemble it! Although I received it for free, I'll write a review based on my experience using it. I'd never used a dishwasher before because it was expensive, didn't clean cleanly, and had been rumored to have a peculiar smell. But now I've found a dishwasher that shatters all my stereotypes: the Media Dishwasher! Let me introduce its advantages! 1. Powerful cleaning power. The most important thing about a dishwasher is how well it cleans and how residue-free it is. But there's really no need to worry. It cleans so thoroughly. I think it's because the Media Dishwasher's high-pressure rotary jet system sprays powerful water from the top and bottom pumps! I'm very satisfied. 2. No peculiar smell. Various washing modes. I love that I can choose the washing mode based on the food I ate that day and the condition of the dishes. There are five functions: 1. Standard wash, 2. Power wash, 3. Eco wash, 4. Quick wash, and 5. Steam sterilization. I usually use the standard wash, but I only use the steam sterilization for my children's bottles and dishes! Then, I can use dishes that are as clean as new. 4. Easy installation and a pretty design. Even women can easily assemble it! The fact that it's a no-punch machine makes it easy to install even if you don't live at home. I installed it by myself in less than 10 minutes when my husband wasn't home. Now, there's only one drawback. Since it's a small dishwasher designed for three people, it won't fit large dishes. I'd recommend this to people who don't own a house, newlyweds, people who live alone, and mothers raising children. When you raise a child, especially a newborn, you use a lot of bottles, so you have to constantly wash them. I wash the bottles after the baby and repeat every day! Although I received it for free, I'll write a review based on my experience using it. I'd never used a dishwasher before because it was expensive, didn't clean cleanly, and had been rumored to have a peculiar smell. But now I've found a dishwasher that shatters all my stereotypes: the Media Dishwasher! Let me introduce its advantages! 1. Powerful cleaning power. The most important thing about a dishwasher is how well it cleans and how residue-free it is. But there's really no need to worry. It cleans so thoroughly. When I first started using the dishwasher, I used to just wipe off almost all the dirt with a blister pack before using it. Now, I just roughly wipe it down and run it through the dishwasher. Whether I use a blister pack or not, it's still clean before and after! I think it's because the Media Dishwasher's high-pressure rotary jet system sprays powerful water from the top and bottom pumps! I'm very satisfied. 2. No peculiar smell. In the past, dishes in my dishwasher had a smell, but with the Media Dishwasher, there's no smell! It washes with hot water at 72 degrees Celsius, so the only smell is the fragrant detergent. 3. Various washing modes. I love that I can choose the washing mode based on the food I ate that day and the condition of the dishes. There are five functions: 1. Standard wash, 2. Power wash, 3. Eco wash, 4. Quick wash, and 5. Steam sterilization. I usually use the standard wash, but I only use the steam sterilization for my children's bottles and dishes! Then, I can use dishes that are as clean as new. 4. Easy installation and a pretty design. Even women can easily assemble it! The fact that it's a no-punch machine makes it easy to install even if you don't live at home. I installed it by myself in less than 10 minutes when my husband wasn't home. Now, there's only one drawback. Since it's a small dishwasher designed for three people, it won't fit large dishes. Since it's a three-person dishwasher, it's small, so large frying pans or dishes won't fit. So I wash the large dishes separately, and compared to before, the amount of dishes I wash has been cut in half, so it's not that inconvenient. For me! I'd recommend this to people who don't own a house, newlyweds, people who live alone, and mothers raising children. When you raise a child, especially a newborn, you use a lot of bottles, so you have to constantly wash them. I wash the bottles after the baby and repeat every day! Having a dishwasher can change your quality of life. And people who hate doing dishes and people who live alone can feel 100% satisfied if they use it! I feel like I spend at least an hour standing in the kitchen. Even if I buy food or snacks for the kids to reduce the amount of dishes, the cooking utensils and dishes end up spilling all over the place. Sometimes my friends come over, and they take out all the dishes and cups~~. I was wondering if there was a dishwasher that I could put in my house? I looked into it! I found a dishwasher that's perfect for all of us in my house! There's no house without a dishwasher these days! I used a dishwasher for the first time in 19 years. I can put the dishes away after eating and use that time to do other things! It's so convenient! My parents-in-law are also the only ones here. She's getting older and always works outside the home. Living alone, my small space and the difficulty of installation kept me from buying one. I chose this one because it said it could be used without a water connection. Being able to see inside is a plus, and I can pause it mid-load to add more dishes. #Cleaning power. Don't doubt its cleaning power. It uses a strong stream of water from above and below, so even on standard settings, it washes the dishwasher more thoroughly than I could by hand. Washing it with hot water disinfects it and dries the dishes quickly, which is great because I can quickly put away the dishes after washing them. #Recommended for 1-2 person households. It can easily hold 2 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 plates, 1 pot, and several spoons. Larger families might need a larger size, but this size is perfect for 1-2 person households, especially for those living alone. It's self-installed and requires no water connection. Since I can fill it myself, it's perfect for homes where construction isn't possible. #Noise. Since it's a motor-driven appliance, it's not completely quiet. But this level of noise... It's like running a washing machine and not noticing it. It's not a bother in everyday life. #Detergent. Be sure to use a dishwasher-specific detergent. #Things to note. Rinse the pre-washed dishes with water before putting them back in. I always wash the filter at the bottom after use. #Cons. I've been using it every day for over a week since I received it. I'm impressed every time I use it, and it's just so convenient and great. Having it is guaranteed to improve your quality of life. +Oh, it would be good to replace the retaining clip that holds the drain hose in place with a different product. It doesn't stay in place. I initially weighed down the hose with something heavy, and it held its shape, so I didn't need the clip. Honestly, washing dishes is one of the most unpleasant chores. Sometimes, I skip cooking and ordering food because I don't want to do it. Now that I'm free from the burden of washing dishes, I feel more relaxed. I delegate tasks to machines or people. I'm just happy I can invest my time in more important things. This product is highly recommended, and the more I use it, the more satisfied I become. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I'm just happy I can invest my time in more important things. This product is highly recommended, and the more I use it, the more satisfied I become.
